landing.description: Set an alert once. We check prices on your routes every hour and send you a full breakdown — flight, hotel, and AI-generated itinerary — the moment a good deal appears.
landing.step1desc: Pick your origin, destinations and travel dates. Takes 30 seconds.
landing.step2desc: We check Google Flights every hour. No browser tab left open. No manual searching.
landing.step3desc: When prices drop, you get an email with the flight, a hotel option and a full trip budget.
landing.sampleScore: Score 84/100 · AI: great value for a long weekend

alerts.title: Set it and forget it
alerts.desc: Define your route and dates once. The system handles all the searching at whatever frequency you choose.
